attchmntText: Easy Trip Planners Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Easy Trip Planners Limited filed a notice with BSE and NSE regarding compliance under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company enclosed newspaper clippings from Financial Express and Jan Satta dated November 15, 2026. These clippings confirm the publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was signed by Priyanka Tiwari, Group Company Secretary and Chief Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Easy Trip Planners Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "EaseMyTrip's Vision 2030 Begins Showing Positive Results: Revenue Grows 33.5%, Hotels & Packages Revenue Surges 188.8% in Q2 FY27".
voiceSummary: EaseMyTrip filed a media release regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results. Revenue from Operations grew 33.5% to 158 crore rupees, while Gross Booking Revenue rose 25.5% to 2,458 crore rupees. For H1 FY27, Revenue from Operations was 293 crore rupees, up 26.1%, and Gross Booking Revenue was 4,829 crore rupees, up 20%. Dubai operations recorded Gross Booking Revenue of 556 crore rupees, a 53.7% increase. Hotels and Packages revenue surged 188.8% to 92 crore rupees. The company commenced electric bus deployment in Bhopal through its arm Easy Green Mobility. It also signed an MoU with the Government of Jharkhand for tourism promotion and secured a mandate from the Punjab Government for pilgrimage travel. The press release highlights progress under the Vision 2030 roadmap, including AI-led innovations and international expansion.

attchmntText: Easy Trip Planners Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: EaseMyTrip filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The presentation details Q2 FY27 performance, reporting Revenue from Operations of INR 158 Cr and Adjusted Income of INR 193 Cr. Gross Booking Revenue reached INR 2,458 Cr, with Dubai Operations contributing INR 556 Cr. For H1 FY27, Revenue from Operations was INR 293 Cr and Adjusted Income was INR 368 Cr. Gross Booking Revenue for the half year stood at INR 4,829 Cr. The company highlighted a 90% plus customer repeat booking rate and growth driven by internal accruals. Audio recordings and transcripts are available on the company website and stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Easy Trip Planners Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Easy Trip Planners Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 14 November 2026. The Board also noted the resignation of Mr. Manmeet Ahluwalia as Chief Marketing Officer, effective 30 November 2026. The company received a Show Cause cum Demand Notice from the Directorate General of Goods and Services Tax Intelligence imposing a penalty of 674.07 million for alleged non-collection of Tax Collected at Source. Management believes it has a strong case and has not recognized any provision. Revenue from operations was 1,579.92 million for the quarter and 2,926.98 million for the half year. Other income stood at 100.28 million for the quarter and 166.05 million for the half year. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements.
